"""Conservative closed-loop navigation policy with safety gating, target
verification, smoothed steering, and hysteresis to reduce oscillation.
"""


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def decide(observation, memory):
    """Select a safe target-directed action using bounded persistent state."""
    memory = dict(memory or {})
    state = memory.get("state", "IDLE")
    scan = memory.get("scan_direction", "SCAN_LEFT")
    previous = memory.get("action", "")

    visible = bool(observation["target_visible"])
    bearing = float(observation["target_bearing"])
    distance = observation["target_distance_class"]
    target_conf = float(observation["target_confidence"])
    identity_conf = float(observation["target_identity_confidence"])
    track_age = int(observation["track_age"])
    lost = int(observation["lost_steps"])
    safety = float(observation["safety_confidence"])
    risk = float(observation["closing_risk"])
    heading = abs(float(observation["heading_error"]))

    if safety < 0.60 or risk >= 0.75:
        memory.update(state="STOPPED", action="STOP")
        return "STOP", 0.99, memory

    trusted = visible and target_conf >= 0.55 and identity_conf >= 0.60
    if not trusted:
        if state in {"LOCKED", "APPROACH", "VERIFY", "REACQUIRE"} or lost:
            memory["state"] = "REACQUIRE"
            if lost <= 1:
                memory["action"] = "STOP"
                return "STOP", 0.92, memory
        memory["scan_direction"] = (
            "SCAN_RIGHT" if scan == "SCAN_LEFT" else "SCAN_LEFT"
        )
        memory["state"] = "SEARCH"
        memory["action"] = scan
        return scan, 0.75, memory

    if track_age < 2:
        memory.update(state="VERIFY", action="SLOW_DOWN")
        return "SLOW_DOWN", 0.80, memory

    if distance == "near":
        if heading <= 15.0 and identity_conf >= 0.80:
            memory.update(state="ARRIVED", action="ARRIVED")
            return "ARRIVED", 0.96, memory
        action = "VEER_LEFT" if bearing < 0 else "VEER_RIGHT"
        memory.update(state="APPROACH", action=action)
        return action, 0.88, memory

    left = bool(observation["corridor_left"])
    right = bool(observation["corridor_right"])
    center = bool(observation["corridor_center"])

    # Hysteresis keeps a valid turn while its target-side corridor remains open.
    if previous == "VEER_LEFT" and left and bearing < 14.0:
        action = previous
    elif previous == "VEER_RIGHT" and right and bearing > -14.0:
        action = previous
    elif bearing < -10.0 and left:
        action = "VEER_LEFT"
    elif bearing > 10.0 and right:
        action = "VEER_RIGHT"
    elif center:
        action = "FORWARD"
    elif bearing < 0 and left:
        action = "VEER_LEFT"
    elif bearing > 0 and right:
        action = "VEER_RIGHT"
    else:
        action = "STOP"

    memory["state"] = "APPROACH" if action != "STOP" else "STOPPED"
    memory["action"] = action
    confidence = 0.90 if action in {"FORWARD", "VEER_LEFT", "VEER_RIGHT"} else 0.98
    return action, confidence, memory
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
